svg.aria-label: Run the wizard: Add the marketplace, install devcore, then ask Claude to "set up my stack profile". The wizard detects the stack, asks only the gaps, writes .claude/stack-profile.md, and prints the plugins to enable. devcore comes along: Every plugin depends on devcore, so installing any of them installs it too. Small context cost: Each enabled skill keeps its one-line Use when description in context, and loads in full only when that line matches. Install what you use: Install only the plugins your stack uses; the rest cost nothing. One step per plugin: Claude Code 2.1.275 or later adds the marketplace on the way. See REFERENCE.md. Update: Run /plugin marketplace update claude-development-skills
